CAVOK is issued when (i) visibility 10 km or more; (ii) no weather of significance; (iii) no clouds below 1500 m or below the highest minimum sector altitude, whichever is greater, and no CB.
qs.ex: CAVOK needs all three conditions together.

qs.q: SPECI is issued when (i) change in wind direction is ≥ 60° and speed before and/or after change ≥ 10 kt; (ii) mean speed has changed by ≥ 10 kt; (iii) variation from mean speed by ≥ 10 kt and speed before and/or after change ≥ 15 kt.
qs.ex: Any one of the wind criteria triggers a SPECI.

qs.q: SPECI is issued when clouds are (i) BKN or OVC base at 30, 60, 150, 300, 450 m; (ii) cloud amount below 450 m changes from SKC/FEW/SCT to BKN/OVC or from BKN/OVC to SKC/FEW/SCT.
qs.ex: Either cloud criterion triggers a SPECI.
